snippet.title: The Lift - Gameplay Trailer | Coming to PC, PS5 & Xbox in 2027
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283240/THE_LIFT_Supernatural_Handyman_Simulator/

You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident.

The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

Coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S in 2027. Wishlist now!

Trailer song: 
Serebryanaya Svadba - Ya Luna (I'm the Moon)
https://open.spotify.com/track/0mBlqYzhSU7NAcUTMKeiDF?si=ad42ce1d259f4a8a
